name: popart
prompt: turn my camera into a four-panel pop-art screen print, each panel in different loud colours
notes: One GLSL TOP: the picture tiled 2x2, each tile's brightness cut into three bands and printed in that tile's three inks, with a faint halftone dot. pop1.uniform1.x and .y are where the shadow and highlight bands start — move them to where your face sits.
